import pandas as pd
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer

# Load the time_series_data dataset
time_series_df = pd.read_csv('/data/time_series_data.csv')

# Drop non-numeric and irrelevant columns
time_series_df = time_series_df.drop(columns=['Unnamed: 0', 'CE', 'calBP', 'kde_all_mean', 'kde_all_std', 'kde_all_detrend', 'g_all_mean', 'g_all_std', 'pollen', 'pollen_inter', 'pollen_detrend', 'pollen_inter_100', 'pollen_grate_100'])

# Replace commas with periods and convert to numeric
time_series_df = time_series_df.apply(lambda x: x.str.replace(',', '.').astype(float) if x.dtype == 'O' else x)

# Impute missing values with the mean of the respective columns
imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy='mean')
time_series_df_imputed = pd.DataFrame(imputer.fit_transform(time_series_df), columns=time_series_df.columns)

# Perform PCA
pca = PCA(n_components=1)
principal_component = pca.fit_transform(time_series_df_imputed)

# Add the principal component to the original dataframe
time_series_df_imputed['PC1'] = principal_component

# Filter the data for the Middle Neolithic (3400-3000 BCE) and Younger Neolithic (2900-2300 BCE) periods
middle_neolithic = time_series_df_imputed[(time_series_df_imputed['CE'] >= -3400) & (time_series_df_imputed['CE'] <= -3000)]
younger_neolithic = time_series_df_imputed[(time_series_df_imputed['CE'] >= -2900) & (time_series_df_imputed['CE'] <= -2300)]

# Calculate the mean PC1 for each period
mean_pc1_middle_neolithic = middle_neolithic['PC1'].mean()
mean_pc1_younger_neolithic = younger_neolithic['PC1'].mean()

mean_pc1_middle_neolithic, mean_pc1_younger_neolithic
